sections.heading: Acceptance
paragraphs: By using Bolcash you agree to these Terms with Bahikha Technologies Private Limited. Effective date: December 2026.

sections.heading: The service
paragraphs: Bolcash helps small businesses in India record income, expenses and customer credit (khata), with optional AI-assisted entry.

sections.heading: Your account
paragraphs: You sign in with your mobile number via OTP. Keep your device secure. You are responsible for the accuracy of the data you enter.

sections.heading: Acceptable use
paragraphs: Use the app lawfully and only for your own business records. Do not misuse it, attempt to break its security, or upload others’ data without a lawful basis.

sections.heading: Your data & content
paragraphs: Your records are yours. You can export or delete them anytime from Settings. Our handling of personal data is described in the Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: AI features & no professional advice
paragraphs: AI features are best-effort and may be wrong — review results before relying on them. The app does not provide accounting, tax, legal or financial advice; consult a professional for those.
